arStrings.szText: "Is that...thing safe? Did we interrupt the ritual?"
Safe? It’s been imbued with demons. It feels familiar. Like Lilith. A little like you.
"Safe? It’s been imbued with demons." Sarcastic and slightly mocking. ISTEL thinks it is a stupid question.
I began this to serve Lilith. I’ve never been one for fate, but this thing is given to me. I shouldn’t refuse such a gift.
Measured, contemplative. She's considering an idea.
I’ll deliver it to the last Faithful. It may yet serve our purpose.
Frank. Matter of fact. She's made up her mind.
